question: From the observed prefix of a batch methane curve, can an interval for the end-of-cycle cumulative yield be given whose coverage holds for unseen bottles, and does an interval-based stopping rule end tests earlier than a fixed-day rule and the 1%-for-3-days criterion at a stated error tolerance?
evidence_role: Retrospective, within-study methodological benchmark on the Sanglier et al. (2022) long cycles. Not external validation, not calibration or transfer of any repository model to Sanglier, and not a treatment-effect analysis. The Sanglier admission decision (sanglier_2022_admission_v1) is unchanged.
disclosure: The point forecaster (recent_rate) was the most accurate method at the 12.5-day cutoff in the existing forecasting benchmark on these same cycles. Its point accuracy is therefore not a new finding. Interval calibration, the normalised score and the stopping rules below have not been computed on these data before this spec was committed.

population.cycles: The 100 long cycles of results/requirements/sanglier_2022_structure_by_cycle.csv (27 bottles, labs BRL and LBE), identical to results/forecasting.
population.sensitivity: Without bottles IV.2 and IV.3 (failing controls).

target.quantity: cumulative methane yield at the last recorded time of the cycle, T_end
target.assumption: T_end is the planned batch length and is known when the forecast is made.
target.unit_handling: All scores are log ratios; the unverified source unit cancels.

cutoffs: Every whole day c with 5 <= c <= T_end - 1; the prefix is all readings with time <= c.

scores.fixed: s = |ln(yhat / y)|, calibrated separately for each cutoff day c
scores.normalised: s = |ln(yhat / y)| / max(g, 0.01), with g = ln(yhat / y_last) the forecaster's own predicted relative remaining gain; one quantile pooled over all cutoffs

conformal_method: Split conformal with CDF pooling over groups (Dunn, Wasserman and Ramdas, 2023): each calibration bottle has total weight 1, shared equally by its (cycle, cutoff) pairs; quantile level min(1, ceil((1 - alpha)(n + 1)) / n) where n is the number of calibration bottles.
tolerance: The interval yhat * exp(-h) to yhat * exp(h) with half-width h <= ln(1.10).

stopping_rules.fixed_day: Stop every cycle at the earliest whole day c at which the fixed-score quantile q_c <= ln(1.10); report yhat at that day.
stopping_rules.adaptive: Stop a cycle at its earliest cutoff c at which q * max(g_c, 0.01) <= ln(1.10); report yhat at that day.
stopping_rules.holliger_1pct: Stop at the first whole day d >= 3 such that, for each of days d-2, d-1 and d, the one-day increment of gross cumulative yield is < 1% of the cumulative yield on that day; report the yield at d (persistence). Adapted: Sanglier yields are gross, not blank-corrected.
stopping_rules.no_stop: A rule that does not fire before T_end is recorded as running to T_end with zero error.

validation_schemes.leave_one_bottle_out: Calibrate on 26 bottles, evaluate the held-out bottle; 27 folds.
validation_schemes.leave_one_lab_out: Calibrate on one laboratory, evaluate the other; 2 folds.

metrics: Bottle-weighted coverage over all (cycle, cutoff) pairs
Bottle-weighted coverage at the stopping time (primary)
Bottle-weighted share of cycles with |yhat/y - 1| <= 10% at the stopping time
Median and quartiles of stopping day and of days saved (T_end - stop)

decision_criteria.C1_calibration: Leave-one-bottle-out coverage over all pairs is within [0.85, 0.95] for both scores.
decision_criteria.C2_coverage_at_stop: Leave-one-bottle-out coverage at the adaptive stopping time is >= 0.85.
decision_criteria.C3_time_saving: Adaptive median stopping day is earlier than the fixed-day rule's stopping day, and the adaptive rule stops before T_end in more than half of the cycles.
decision_criteria.C4_transfer: Leave-one-lab-out coverage at the adaptive stopping time is >= 0.85 in both directions; otherwise report that the rule does not transfer between laboratories.
decision_criteria.reporting: All criteria, all rules and both populations are reported whether they pass or fail. No criterion, threshold, score or cutoff grid is changed after the first run.
